These instructions are generally called as a prompt. You will be provided with a sample prompt for this, to get started.

slides.title: Building a Static Website with Gen AI
slides.body:
Prompt
Act as a skilled front-end web developer specializing in creating perfect static websites from design mockups. Build a static website with HTML and CSS code that replicates the provided design mockup with 100% accuracy by following the below guidelines:
Guidelines:
Design the static website to match the provided mockup exactly in terms of layout, structure, and appearance.
Use valid image links from Unsplash that best fit the design elements.
Match the colors, fonts, styles, spacing, borders, and shadows as shown in the mockup.
Use the provided icons and ensure they are styled and placed correctly.
slides.notes:
You can take this as reference and update it according to your needs.
Feel free to update and improvise this. You can write your own prompt according to your specific idea for a website, whether it's a portfolio, a blog, or something else entirely. 
The more descriptive and clear you are, the better the AI can understand your goal and generate relevant content.
Writing Prompts is also a very important skill. You can learn all about this in a separate course.

slides.title: Anyone Having Technical Expertise
slides.notes:
Yes, people who have technical knowledge. For websites, it is HTML , CSS, and JS. These are the strong foundations.

May be without technical knowledge, you can build small to medium applications, with few bugs but in order to maintain for longer time and add more functionalities to it, you should have strong technical expertise. This is generally how the web application development actually is..

The strong expertise in these foundations is really needed because

slides.title: Building a Static Website with Gen AI
slides.body:
Technical Expertise
Helps in refining AI output
Allows to get clear understanding                                     of requirements
Allows to make adjustments to match exact design needs
…many more
slides.notes:
Technical knowledge allows us to make precise adjustments to match exact design needs. 
Having that technical background also helps immensely in refining AI output. When the AI gives you code, you can quickly identify what's good, what needs tweaking, and how to improve it. You're not just accepting what it gives you; you're actively collaborating with it.
Finally, technical knowledge allows for clearly expressing your requirements. The better you understand the web technologies, the better you can give your needs to the AI in your prompts, leading to far more accurate and usable results.
Ultimately, these AI tools are powerful accelerators. They empower those with technical knowledge to work faster, smarter, and build more web applications.They don't replace expertise; they amplify it.
Without understanding the basics, you're limited to what the AI thinks you want. With knowledge, you can guide it, correct it, and push its boundaries to create exactly what you want. You move from being a consumer of AI output to a masterful director.

slides.title: Technical Knowledge
slides.body:
Learning
Master the Fundamentals - Core Programming Concepts, Problem Solving & Debugging, etc 
Practice hands-on with minimal AI support
slides.notes:
So, lets conclude..

As a full-stack development learner, your primary focus should be on practical coding skills. AI tools like ChatGPT are helpful, but remember: AI should assist, not replace your learning process.

 1. Master the Basics First

Start by getting a solid understanding of HTML, CSS. Before turning to AI, learn how these core technologies work. AI tools are tempting because they offer instant solutions, but without mastering the fundamentals, you won’t fully understand or adapt AI-generated code.

Why this matters: A strong foundation in the basics allows you to work independently and understand the code generated by AI, making it easier to apply or modify it effectively.

 2. Focus on Hands-on Practice, Use AI for Support

Write your own code by building projects. Use AI to assist with repetitive tasks like boilerplate code or to debug issues. But the bulk of the work — coding the logic and building the features — should be done by you.

Why this works: Active practice is where you’ll truly develop your skills. AI can help with small challenges but writing code on your own is where you grow as a developer.

slides.title: Technical Knowledge
slides.body:
Learning
Use AI for Guidance, Not for Solutions
Understand AI generated Code
Double-Check AI generated Code
slides.notes:
3. Solve Problems Yourself First, Then Use AI

When you face a challenge, try solving it on your own first. Once you’ve made an attempt, then use AI to verify or suggest improvements.

Why this works: The struggle in problem-solving strengthens your understanding. AI is a tool to check your solution, not to bypass the process. When AI provides suggestions, focus on improving your skills instead of relying on it for the answer.

 4. Understand the Code AI Provides

AI might generate code for you, but don’t just copy-paste it. Make sure you understand the logic and flow of the code.

Why this matters: Understanding AI-generated code ensures that you can modify and debug it when needed. You’ll learn more by asking questions like: *Why was this approach used? How does it work with my project?*

 5. Double-Check AI Code

Always review and validate AI-generated code. Don’t trust it blindly, and ensure it follows best practices.

Why this matters: AI can make mistakes or suggest suboptimal solutions. By double-checking the code, you can ensure it meets the specific needs of your project and follows best practices.


So,

Use AI is a Tool to Enhance, Not Replace, Your Learning

Use AI wisely by focusing on self-learning and practical coding.

By combining hands-on practice with AI support, you’ll become a confident full-stack developer, ready to solve real-world problems.
